identity.name: Mechi Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Mechi Multiple Campus is a premier constituent campus of Tribhuvan University located in Bhadrapur, Jhapa, offering various undergraduate and graduate programs.
identity.description: Mechi Multiple Campus was established in 1973 AD (2030 BS) as a community campus and later integrated into Tribhuvan University as a constituent campus. It is one of the oldest and largest higher education institutions in Jhapa district, catering to thousands of students in management, humanities, science, and education streams.
